question.text: The initial public offer of an InvIT shall be open for subscription for a minimum period of ___ days and maximum period of ___ days.

explanation.text: The Logic: Under InvIT Regulations, the initial public offer and follow-on offer of an InvIT shall be open for subscription for a minimum period of 3 days and a maximum period of 30 days. The Trap: Other shorter windows used for different products may seem plausible, but the InvIT rule is specifically 3-30 days. Note: The same 3-day minimum and 30-day maximum apply both to the initial public offer and to a follow-on offer of InvIT units.
